{{recipe}}

The original contributor of this recipe provided the following anecdote:<blockquote>''"This was the first thing I could cook. I learned to make it staying with a friend as I was leaving the Navy. For years I have called it 'Keith's Whats-it.'"''</blockquote>

==Ingredients==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] uncooked [[cookbook:Pasta|pasta]], such as [[cookbook:Macaroni|macaroni]], elbows, or wagon wheels
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (about 500 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[cookbook:Ground Beef|ground beef]], crumbled
* a sprinkle of [[Cookbook:Garlic Salt|garlic salt]]
* a sprinkle of [[Cookbook:Mince|minced]] [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]]
* 1–2 cans condensed [[cookbook:Tomato|tomato]] [[Cookbook:Soup|soup]]

==Procedure==
# [[cookbook:Boil|Boil]] pasta in 4–6 cups salted, oiled water until [[Cookbook:Al Dente|al dente]]. Drain.
# While pasta is cooking, sprinkle a 10-[[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (25 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) [[Cookbook:Frying Pan|skillet]] with garlic salt and minced onion, and brown beef.
# Add tomato soup and cook a minute or two.
# Stir in drained pasta.

==Notes, tips and variations==
* May add beans, vary spices, add onions; anything you like!
* Makes a decent chili base with chili powder added.
* Good in leftovers, if that is possible.
